description: This file defines the ServerRequest class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which extends the Request class to implement the PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface. It provides methods for creating server-side HTTP request objects, including handling server parameters, headers, URI, uploaded files, and request body data. The class also includes static factory methods to create instances from PHP globals.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Represents an immutable server-side HTTP request, extending the basic Request class by adding methods for server-specific data such as server parameters, cookies, uploaded files, query parameters, and attributes. It includes static methods to create instances from PHP globals, facilitating easy integration with PHP's superglobals.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Normalizes an array of uploaded files structures into an array of UploadedFileInterface instances, handling nested file specifications.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a PHP $_FILES style file specification array.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Normalizes nested $_FILES array structures into individual UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object from PHP's superglobals ($_SERVER, $_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES), integrating server request data with PSR-7 interfaces.

methods.name: extractHostAndPortFromAuthority
methods.description: Parses a host:port string to extract components, returning host and port separately.

methods.name: getUriFromGlobals
methods.description: Constructs a UriInterface instance based on PHP superglobals, including scheme, host, port, path, and query.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns the server parameters passed during instantiation.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns the uploaded files stored in this request instance.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified query parameters.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed request body, typically form data.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified parsed body data.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute with an optional default.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specific attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified attribute.
